headline: Pear Suite wins Inno Fire award for innovation in Hawaii healthcare tech

signals.summary: Pear Suite named as one of eight innovative Hawaii companies by Pacific Business News Inno Fire Awards 2026. Positive brand recognition and third-party validation of their HealthTech capabilities.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to congratulate the leadership team on the award win and explore a case-study collaboration showcasing how Pear Suite uses Paubox to maintain HIPAA compliance while scaling their innovation-focused platform.

headline: Pear Suite secures $900K grant from Health Net for Medi-Cal community health initiatives; growing adoption among healthcare systems

signals.summary: Health Net awarded Pear Suite a $900,000 grant to support California community health workers and doulas serving Medi-Cal members. This signals strong adoption of Pear Suite's platform by a major payer and expansion of their health equity use cases.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to the Pear Suite product team to understand which use cases and workflows (patient communication, provider coordination, intake) will be powered by this grant; explore if HIPAA-compliant email, forms, or transactional APIs are part of the expansion, and offer a complementary security audit or email archiving trial.

signals.summary: HealthCatalyst Northwest Arkansas selected Pear Suite for a $20,000 community pilot project, indicating early-stage adoption and validation within healthcare innovation networks.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor Pear Suite's progress in the HealthCatalyst cohort; use this as a touchpoint to introduce Paubox's secure patient intake (Forms) and transactional email (Email API) services, which often scale with pilot-to-production transitions.

headline: Pear Suite secures $900K Health Net grant to expand Medi-Cal community care operations
